ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the outermost layer of the cell?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a labeled schematic diagram of a plant cell. Outside the cell there is a circle of thick rectangular boundary, and on the lower right there is an arrow and a label pointing to this external boundary, with the label reading “Cell wall”. The diagram also labels structures such as Mitochondrion, Vacuole, Chloroplast, Nucleus, Endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, Plasmodesmata, Ribosome, etc. Reasoning: The question asks what the outermost layer of the cell is. In the diagram, the outermost boundary layer is clearly labeled as “Cell wall”, therefore the outermost layer of the cell is Cell Wall.
